description: Look up a 6-11 digit payment-card prefix. Returns the actual longest matched prefix, issuer, country, brand key, brand name, card type and prepaid status where known. Unknown fields are null. Does not confirm a card or account exists. Pooled request on every plan.

bin.description: Card prefix as a string, 6-11 digits. Preserve leading zeros. Spaces and hyphens are accepted.

deep.description: Include an empty deep object. No extra fields or separate charge.

name: bin
